items.how: Confirmed in the thesis, §2's reading, §4's table and paragraph, §4.4's definition and Sen paragraph, the dated note and T8: 'on a finite listing, widening is exactly what every additive weighting that counts each listed thing above zero ranks higher' is widens_iff_every_positive (Positive = every listed item weighted above zero, weighed = additive natural sum, Bool admission). The class clause, 'a class of orders that need not be additive shares it only where every order in it already ranks each widening higher', is exact as a necessary condition (the theorem's sufficiency also takes the class to hold every positive weighting's order, and that containment is not necessary, so 'only where' is the right form). 'Every way of counting each thing as worth something' is gone from 07 and its records. §2 and §4.4's table keep 'every positive weighting', defined in §4.4 as additive: correct.

items.item: H2 no premise beside the life's own concern
items.how: Confirmed in the thesis, §4's paragraph and the closing paragraph; the added sentence that the proof uses the condition only at the life's own standpoint p matches the Lean (`ownClosure_unrestricted_iff.mp unrestricted p`, and the docstring's 'Of `unrestricted` only its instance at `p` is used'). The dated note says 'C is no longer introduced as a second foundation of the ethics; the name stays for the requirement particular theorems take'; its heading history ('two premises' from 23 October, 'two readings' and then 'How scope and order emerge together from continuation' on 9 November) was checked against git (0d7a397a5, a7254387a, 22f65660c). 'second premise' remains in 07 only inside that dated note.

'argued, not shown' is gone from 07 for the order's formation; every remaining 'argued' is about the step of invariance, the unfolding thesis, P2-P4 or the crux. The new sentences match 07 §4.9's last paragraph ('a filter on what was chosen, not a mechanism forming an order') and its record. 'Neither the condition nor self-concern stands above becoming: each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and whether and how formations come to hold them is the open target' is H3's wording; 08 §12 item 12 exists ('How scope and order form').

Thesis and T8 say 'need not count ... nothing in it requires their losses to count'; §3.3's Clearing.center_not_derived is a witness, and IncreasingInOwn constrains only the rankings it imposes. 07 has no lake sentence.

items.item: H6 the acyclic result and time
items.how: 'as among dated occurrences' is gone from 07; 'on an acyclic relation, where it holds, every standpoint has the same center' matches «续无外则同一中心» exactly (no standpoint asserted). 'read across all steps' replaces 'without time'; §3's 'dependence and exchange each at some step, in either order; being affected itself carries no step' matches AffectedBy. Nothing is said of what holds in time. §3.3's 'so the second law bites on a dated net' dropped; its quotes are only in ZB's study notes (history).
'continues with' remains in 07 only in §2 about causal sets (unrelated). The reach reading and «续无外» gloss are as H7 asks.
No 'courses that end' left in 07 or the records outside history.

Checked the composition: unrestricted_of_mutuallyDependent outputs Unrestricted (selfAscribed (ownClosure (L.AffectedBy W)) center), and extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn takes Unrestricted (selfAscribed (ownClosure rel) center) for any rel on the same W; 'one application of the second to the first, still taking an order self-concerned on a listing' is exact (the marking, decided admission and listing are also taken, as 07 states beside it).

Thesis keeps the sentence and then says what is shown (self-concern a hypothesis, condition de se, finite listing and one way between paths whose admissions end), what is offered (counting the loss of those who depend on one, the step of invariance) and what is open (08 §12 item 12, with §4.9's filter).

No should beyond becoming opens the thesis; each restated theorem matches its Lean; history fields, the before-copy and Ren's quoted words untouched (the correspondence's Ren quotes compared programmatically, en and zh); no person named; no generated page edited (OPEN-QUESTIONS.md, RESULTS.md untouched); navigation line, every heading and every explicit anchor identical to HEAD; every in-page link in the changed sentences resolves; J1's four places untouched; §3.5, §4.9, §4.10 theorem statements untouched.
